additions.text: Say one word or a short sentence.
Which stop do you like best? Why?
There is a spell. The kingdom is asleep. Go to the village. Look for Inés.
There are thorns on the castle. The kingdom is asleep. I am not asleep.
Hello again! Do you want some tea?
The scroll says: "A shelter must have an exit." The spell is a shelter.
Do you have photos from when you were little?
The spell is mine. I want to protect Elara.
Hi. First, talk to Nox, the raven on the road.
Hi. First, talk to Nox on the road.
The village needs help. First, the mill and the key.
The forest is dark. First, the light in the forest.
First, talk to Sir Aldren at the bridge.
First, look for the scroll in the library.
First, bring the scroll from the library.
My fire is dangerous. First, learn Aurora.
First, talk to Brum and bring the crystal.
Elara is asleep. The altar needs light, life and dawn.
Ha, ha. The machine is very old.
You are in the waiting room. Don Anselmo has a sore throat. He waits a long time: eight hours.
Do you look at your phone when you wait?
Do you talk to new people?
Do you prefer coffee or tea?
Doña Pilar is in the good chairs. She has a splinter in her finger. Next to her is a man in a grey cardigan. He is tired. He is the director. Nobody knows.
Alonso says: “The hospital needs chairs.” Pilar goes red.
Do you have a grey cardigan?
Green, madam. And a glass of water.
Now you have a cat and a guitar.
Do you prefer red or green?
Do you dance on your day off?
You are in the emergency ward. Doctor Íñigo has been here since yesterday. He doesn’t sleep. His eyes are red.
Do you work a lot or a little?
An ambulance arrives. Yamilé and Manuel bring in Kevin. There is blood on his leg. He has his phone in his hand.
Hi, friends! I’m in the hospital! A thousand people are watching me!
Ezequiel has a broken arm. There is blood on his forehead. Doctor Catalina puts on the cast.
Ezequiel goes red: “Paola is pretty, isn’t she?”
Paola smiles. The cat comes out of the box.
Would you climb a ladder for love?
Is your home big or small?
Do you have a friend for bad days?
Do you rest at the weekend?
You are in the cafeteria. The menu is very old. A surgeon eats standing up. He has blood on his clothes.
Do you eat chocolate when you’re sad?
Say your favourite food. Is it pizza?
You have no money. But you have a pretty receipt.
Jorge writes a long complaint: fifteen pesos.
Is food expensive in your country?
Andrea looks at you: “Is your blood A or B?”
Say your star sign. Is it Leo?
Is there a key in your pocket?
You are upstairs with Tania, behind a glass window. Downstairs, two surgeons operate and argue.
Do you prefer opera or reggaeton?
Is your holiday in summer or in winter?
You are in the staff room. Doctor Rodrigo is on the sofa. He is under a blanket. His phone is ringing. It smells of fish.
Rodrigo goes to the operating room. The blanket is on his head.
Now there are two people on the sofa.
Do you sleep better on the sofa or in bed?
Do you watch TV to relax?
Roberto opens the door. The robot wants water.
Do you have a lot of work today?
Don Mario walks with his drip. His gown is open at the back. He goes to the stairs. He wants to smoke.
The next day, Mario says: “Tomorrow, zero.”
Is it hard to give up coffee?
Do you have a small pleasure every day?
Do you like celebrating your birthday?
Do you talk to your family a lot?
Do you like listening to the radio?
Do you eat chicken for lunch?
You are in the service corridor. Doña Lorena cleans blood off the floor. A stretcher goes by. A doctor runs. She is calm.
Lorena looks at you: “What do you want, love?”
Do you like working at night?
Do you prefer Monday or Friday?
I wash the hospital sheets. There is everything in the sheets. There are teeth, rings and a glass eye. I have a box with a hundred things.
I am here for my knee. I have been waiting since 2019. Now my knee is fine. But the other one is bad.
Hi, I am live. My tummy hurts a lot. Ten thousand people are watching my pain.
What? Who are you? I am asleep. I am not ill. I sleep here: it is free.
Look at my head. There is a sign on the floor. The sign says «Welcome». It is very heavy.
Wife of a man with the remote in his tummy
I am sad. The TV remote is inside my husband. It is in his tummy.
Young man with a very strong grandmother
I have a broken arm. My grandmother is ninety. She is very strong. I am not.
I am a cook. I am missing a finger. My finger is in the cool box. It is with the chorizo.
Lawyer who wants to sue the hospital
I am a lawyer. I am very angry. I want to sue the hospital. But the hospital is suing me.
Do you get angry a lot?
I have been on this stretcher since Monday. My gown is open at the back. Everybody sees my bottom.
I have blood on my leg. It is because of my motorbike. Is my bike OK?
My face is very big. It is the hospital soup. I am allergic to the soup.
Football fan with a broken head
Ouch, it hurts a lot! The aerial is on the roof. The final is on today. I go up… and I come down very fast.
I am a doctor. I am twenty-six. Today is my first operation. I am watching a video online.
I have the hospital bill. It is very expensive. I pay for the air!
I am looking for my dad. He is in the hospital. But nobody knows where. I talk to lots of people.
I am in the street, near the door. I am phoning the hospital. I have been on hold with music for three hours.
Man on the floor next to a sign
I have blood on my head. I am here for a tooth. But here the ceiling falls down.
Do you look at the ceiling in buildings?
Woman who comes in with a nosebleed
Man with a key in his stomach
I am in X-ray. I have a key in my stomach. My wife is in the street. She can’t get into the house.
Are your keys in your pocket?
I am eighty-one. I am a surgeon. My hands shake, but only a little.
Do you have very old grandparents?
Do you sleep a lot or a little?
I am ninety-four. I live in this room. It is my home.
I am under observation. A long time: three weeks. I don’t know what is wrong with me.
I am a midwife. I help babies to be born. That man is on the floor! Up you get, sir!
Where am I? I am on the floor. My wife is having a baby. I am sleepy.
Mmm… Hi. I don’t speak well. I have a tube. I blink once: «yes». I blink twice: «no».
Mmm… Is the hospital good or bad?
I am alive. But for the hospital, I am dead. The man from the morgue comes every day.
Daughter who lives very far away
I am Doña Pilar’s daughter. I live far away, in another country. My mum is fine. I am very tired.
There are lights. Rocco is the doorman. "Hello. What's your name?"
My name is Valentina. And you?
"I'm Rocco. Nice to meet you." Rocco smiles.
"Duarte? Oh!" Rocco looks at your eyes.
Rocco looks at you. "Are you Ernesto's daughter?"
"Ernesto is my friend." Rocco is sad.
Rocco looks at the chip. "Floor three! Oh dear!"
Do you have a secret? Yes or no?
Marisol is at reception. "Hello. Do you have a booking?"
No. But I have a smile.
I don't know. I'm Valentina Duarte.
Marisol looks at the screen. "Duarte… Duarte…"
"Oh! You have a suite. And it's free!"
"Yes. A jacuzzi and champagne." Marisol smiles.
Do I have a secret admirer?
"Yes. From floor three." Marisol gives you a key.
You have a gold key. What a night!
Is your home big or small?
Is there a hotel on your street?
Say one thing in your room. A bed?
There are lots of machines. Doña Pilar is playing. "This machine is mine!"
Sorry. Is it your favourite machine?
"Yes. It's my machine. It's my love."
Pilar gives you a coffee. "Here you go, love."
Do you play here every night?
Pilar looks at you. "Are you Ernesto's daughter?"
Yes. Does he have a favourite number?
Yes. Is he a good man?
"Yes. And very handsome." Pilar looks at the ceiling.
You play. Ding, ding! Pilar claps. "Bravo!"
Pilar gives you a chip. "For number seventeen."
Do you have a favourite number?
Are you lucky? Yes or no?
Do you play games on your phone?
Say a number from one to twenty.
There's a roulette wheel. Nico is the dealer. "Red or black?"
Nico looks at the chip. "Everything? Very good!"
A man with a cigar speaks. "Seventeen? It's an old number."
The ball lands on seventeen. You win!
Do you have a cigar for me?
"Yes. Here." The man looks at you a lot.
The man with the cigar is gone. There's another table.
Sam is playing cards. There are two guards. "Hi, gorgeous. Are you playing?"
Yes. Do you win a lot, Sam?
Yes. And you pay for the drinks.
Sam speaks quietly. "There's a man in grey. Look."
Is he tall? Is he bad?
You talk to the guards. Sam is gone.
You look. There's a man in grey. And nothing more.
Do you like whisky? Yes or no?
Do you play games with your family?
Ten men are drinking and shouting. Kike is the groom. "Hi! Come here!"
"Yes! But tonight I'm free." Everyone laughs.
Kike has the dice. "Here. For luck!"
You throw the dice. Seven! Everyone shouts.
All right. And you pay for dinner.
And your fiancée? Where is she?
A friend gives you matches: "Emerald Room".
Party at home or in a bar?
Do you drink beer or water?
Say a number from one to twelve.
Dolores is at the cash desk. She doesn't smile. "Hello. What do you want?"
Hi, Dolores. What a lovely necklace!
Dolores almost smiles. She looks at your chip.
Dolores looks at the chip. She's pale.
"No. This chip isn't for here. It's for upstairs."
Are there many chips like this?
Do you have a lot of money in your bag? Yes or no?
Say one old thing in your home.
The bar is nice. Chet plays the piano. Leo speaks. "What are you drinking?"
Leo gives you a red cocktail. "It's called Midnight."
Leo gives you water with lemon.
Chet looks at Valentina. "It's Ernesto's song."
Chet looks at the piano. "I don't know."
Leo, will you dance with me?
Leo dances with you. Chet sings.
Leo speaks quietly. "There's a story about cards."
What do you drink in a bar?
There are screens with horses. Ramiro watches. "Come on, number five!"
Do you have a lot of money on number five?
"Yes. All my money." Ramiro is pale.
Number five doesn't win. Ramiro is sad. "The owner plays too."
Do you want a coffee, Ramiro?
I'm playing too. I'm looking for my father.
Ramiro looks at you. "That's a big game."
Ramiro watches the football. There's a green room.
Do you watch sport on TV?
The room is green. A man has dark glasses. "I'm the Dutchman."
I want to talk about Ernesto Duarte.
The Dutchman looks at Valentina. "Ah. Like your father."
"This table is famous. Ernesto wins the casino here."
You play. You win! "You have Ernesto's hands."
There's lots of food. Tere is the cook. "Are you hungry?"
"The fish. And the secrets." Tere laughs.
"Don Aurelio is the owner. He's old and ill."
You eat a strawberry with chocolate. Delicious!
Faustino is a magician. Estrella is a dancer. "Hello, miss!"
Hi. Is there magic for me?
"Yes! Do you have something special?" You give him your chip.
"Thank you." Faustino looks. "And me?" You give him your chip.
I have a chip. Is it magic?
Do you have a password on your phone?
There's a pink chapel. Elvis is singing. "Hi! Are you the witness?"
Yes. And then I sing with you.
Elvis looks at Valentina. "Is it true love?"
I don't know. But it's Las Vegas!
The bride gives you flowers. "For you!"
There's music and lights. A man in grey is watching. He's not dancing.
Hi. Will you dance with me?
"No. I'm working." But he moves one foot.
Why are you looking at me?
"I'm Bruno. Don Aurelio wants to talk. He's upstairs."
You dance one more song. Bruno watches.
All right. But you pay for the drink.
You go to the lift with Bruno. Floor three.
There's a black door. Bruno and Tano are here. "Password?"
Tano looks at the bag. "What have you got there?"
Tano looks at the chip. "Go in."
A red lipstick. Do you want it?
Bruno and Tano laugh. "Go in, go in."
You go in. There's a red carpet. It's quiet.
Do you have lipstick? Yes or no?
Say one thing in your bag.
The Countess has diamonds. "Hello, darling. Are you playing?"
I don't know how to play. Is it hard?
"No. It's very easy. Nine is good."
"Yes. Everything is real. Except my name."
The Countess has lots of chips. "Bank or player?"
No, thank you. I'm not playing.
The Countess drinks champagne. "Your father is clever."
Are you brave? Yes or no?
Do you play easy or hard games?
Say a number from one to nine.
There are serious men. They're drinking whisky. Don Carmine speaks. "Out!"
Don Carmine looks at Valentina. "Ah. You've got character."
I want to talk to Don Aurelio.
"Everyone wants to talk to him. Sit down."
Do you have a cigar for me?
"Your father has something of the Family's."
The men look at each other. Nobody speaks.
"No. A piece of paper. A secret."
Do you have brothers or sisters?
Do you like smoke? Yes or no?
Say a person in your family.
Ignacio has white gloves. There are photos. "Hello. Would you like a coffee?"
No, thanks. Who's in the photo?
Ignacio has a photo. "It's your father. With Don Aurelio."
"It's a bet. A bet between the two of them."
Ignacio gives you the photo. "Yes. It's for you."
You look at the photo. Your father is young.
Would you like a coffee now?
Are there photos in your home?
Is your father tall or short?
Say a person in a photo.
It's windy. There's a nice view. A young man is watching. "Hi, Valentina."
Marco has an envelope. "A million dollars. It's for you. But you go home."
No, thanks. I want the truth.
I like money. But I love my father.
Marco doesn't speak. He looks at a door.
Marco is furious. There's an office.
Do you want a million dollars?
Does your home have a terrace?
Don Aurelio is in the office. He's ill. "Hello, Valentina."
"Yes. Very ill." He gives you a whisky.
"Your father wins the casino. I don't pay. He goes far away."
And now? What do you want?
"There are two gifts. The casino or your father."
"Yes. Now, the casino or your father?"
"There's more." There are two papers on the table.
The casino or your father? It's midnight.
Do you like your office or your home?
Is your family far or near?
Billy is a cowboy. He's drunk. "Please! You're my wife!"
The guards look. Billy is happy.
Billy cries. "My love!" The guards laugh.
Billy, how much whisky are you drinking?
A guard speaks. "Madam, does Billy go out on the street?"
No. He goes to his room.
Billy goes out on the street. He sings.
Billy gives you his hat. "For you!"
Are you married? Yes or no?
There are lights and music. Yolanda is a grandmother. She wins lots of money! "I'm rich!"
Yolanda gives you a hug. "Thank you!"
"Two million!" Yolanda is red in the face.
You dance with Yolanda. Everyone watches.
"I have three children. They want money. Do I tell them?"
Yolanda gives you a hundred dollars. "For you!"
Do you have children? Yes or no?
Say a city for a holiday.
Gus has a wig. The guards are with him. "Psst. A favour?"
"There's something in the toilets. Behind the mirror."
"There's money behind the mirror. It's for my sister."
"On Fremont Street. Her name is Lupe."
The guards go with Gus. There's a wig on the floor.
Is your hair long or short?
Is there a mirror in your room?
Andrés is on the floor. He's sad. He has no money. "Do you want my watch?"
"No. My daughter has a wedding. There's no money."
I don't want the watch. But I'll talk with you.
"My daughter has a wedding. I have no money. Do I talk to her?"
The truth. Your daughter loves you.
You have a job. That's important.
Andrés goes to the door. He looks at the roulette.
Do you go by taxi or by bus?
Are you sad or happy today?
Cinthia is the bride. She's with friends. "Hi! Drink with us!"
They all shout. You drink a pink drink.
A little. Do you drink a lot?
Cinthia speaks quietly. "Do I want the wedding? I don't know."
Cinthia gives you her veil. "For you!"
Do you have lots of friends?
Do you drink a lot of water?
Toño and a man are shouting. It's about football. "You! Who's right?"
Toño is happy. The man is red in the face.
It's a goal! Toño is very happy.
There are two guards. "Any problems?" "No, no!"
Do you have a favourite team?
Do you watch football on TV?
Do you shout a lot? Yes or no?
Marta is the bride. She's furious. Her husband is asleep. "Help!"
Marta throws water. He looks. "Hi, love."
"He's handsome. And I drink a lot."
Marta cries. "I don't want the wedding. What do I do?"
You don't want it. You're free!
Marta goes to the chapel. "Elvis! No!"
Look at your husband. He's handsome.
Marta looks. "Yes… he's handsome." She laughs.
Marta is with her husband. He's asleep. What a couple!
Do you like sleeping a lot?
Sergio is very rich. He has a cigar. He burns money. "Hi, gorgeous."
"A game with you. My red car."
"A coin. Heads? The car is yours. Tails? Dinner with me."
It's heads! Sergio gives you the keys.
Sergio has another cigar. The models watch.
Julián is rich. He has a yacht. "A card? All or nothing!"
"My father doesn't talk to me." Julián is sad.
There are two cards. "Left or right?"
It's a two. Julián has no yacht.
Julián goes to the door. There's music.
Do you talk to your father?
Flash! It's a photo of the senator. He's with a woman. She's not his wife.
"She's at home." The senator is nervous.
The photographer shouts. "It's my camera!" The senator looks at Valentina.
Everyone looks at you. The senator is happy.
The photographer has his camera. He goes fast.
I'm not looking at anything. I'm going to the bar.
You go to the bar. What a night!
The woman goes to the door. The senator is serious.
Are there lots of photos on your phone?
Do you like politics? Yes or no?
It is Saturday. It is night. Today is Vale’s birthday. There is a party. Walk around. Choose a place and go in.
It is raining. The café, the bar or the square?
Is it at the bar, in the taxi or in the square?
Which place is your favourite? Say one.
Do you go to work by bus or on foot?
Sebastián smiles. He opens the door for a guest.
Don Emilio opens his car. He drives away slowly.
You have a card. It has the name of a wine on it.
Is today a good day or a bad one?
